note: SRA on the 1,000-acre Lake Maloney (the Platte power-canal reservoir) 6 mi S of North Platte. The camping is in the park's north-west corner: the Kansas Point loop on the peninsula, whose pads along the north edge face the inlet across open grass, and a strip of sites along the inlet's north bank. Self-pay iron ranger. Two boat ramps. --Claude
summary: NGPC grid confirms Electric Plus + Basic sites at statewide rates, no reservations (no '*'), phone 308-535-8025; not on ReserveAmerica. Fees 10-15 -> 10-30 (basic off-season to electric plus in season), electric surcharge cleared; booking confirmed FCFS. Pin was in the water, 62 m off the Kansas Point loop. Lakefront kept (pads face the inlet over open ground). Count 126 and facilities unverified (outdoornebraska.gov blocked).
